title: Chapter 41 — The Trade Channel: Why It Exists
intro: The second engine — what trade business is and the career mathematics of an account book.

sections.title: The Second Engine
sections.content:
Retail walk-in traffic is one revenue engine. The trade channel — builders, contractors, designers, property managers — is the second. A strong trade book provides predictable, repeating revenue that does not depend on foot traffic.

The career math is compelling. One builder account doing 20 kitchens a year at $15,000 average is $300,000 in annual revenue from a single relationship. Build five accounts like that and you have built a business.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating trade awareness, ask:

Does the salesperson understand the trade channel as a revenue opportunity?
Are they building trade relationships — or only waiting for retail walk-ins?
